risks.summary: CoreAudio release-equivalent 5:59 x3 final absolute drift was 6,078 / 2,387 / 4,186 us; max and p95 6,078 us exceed the 5,000 us target.

At configured 60 fps, frame-time p95/p99 were 16,667 us with 35 over-budget samples and 121,646 us max including injected stalls; note pool max was 8/64 with zero overflow. Release heap monitor returned zero and remains a Phase 2 instrumentation risk.

Recorded burst acceptance-to-Gameplay processing p50/p95/p99 was 6,516 / 8,295 / 9,764 us; p95 exceeds the 5,000 us target. Godot exposes no OS receive timestamp, so this excludes device-to-engine latency.
The baseline exporter reports a sandbox Trash permission warning when replacing an existing ZIP, although export exits successfully.

Performance.MEMORY_STATIC returned zero in the release export, so heap allocation totals were unavailable. Product per-frame collections are preallocated and the note pool had zero overflow, but an external allocation profiler remains required.

The first P113 clean launch failed because product code enumerated MIDI ports before opening CoreMIDI. Open-before-enumerate and a cold-start regression test were added; replacement P112 runs j/k and all three accepted P113 sessions passed.

The physical USB disconnect/reconnect recovered without relaunch, but Godot exposed no port-list disconnect event. Device Setup must provide explicit reopen/relaunch guidance and must not infer disconnect from silence alone.

phase1_gate.reason: The fixed-song product slice and three real-device sessions passed. Long-run drift and recorded-burst MIDI dispatch remain mandatory release-gate work but do not block unrelated feature development.
